tagline: 雅西卡旁轴相机，1970 年发布
description: 雅西卡于1970年推出的旁轴相机。配备35mm, f/1.8, 6 elements in 4 groups.。快门速度8 sec - 1/250 sec.。使用Overexposure and slow (<1/30s) shutter speed warning arrows.。感光度ISO 25-500.。Superimposed rectangle, rangefinder-type.。

specs.曝光测光: CdS cell located above front lens element.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in X-synchronization via PC socket, no hot-shoe.
specs.胶片/画幅: Overexposure and slow (<1/30s) shutter speed warning arrows.
specs.电池: Single 6V PX28, battery check illuminates frame counter.
specs.英文简介: The Electro 35 CC is a compact 35mm rangefinder camera from Yashica released in 1970.
